discoveries.text: The full suite takes ~9-10 min under load now (548 s): a Bash background waiter needs a timeout over 600 s or it is killed.

gc's worktree loop now only removes harness/<run> worktrees; a merged clean one on another branch prints 'keeps <wt>: not a run worktree (branch <b>)'. The local branch pass skips branches checked out in any worktree (no more 'cannot delete branch … used by worktree' noise).
HARNESS_GC_TIMEOUT (env, default 10m) bounds the runner's gc; the suite's runner-gc failure check uses 2s with a fetch that sleeps 60.

questions: Should a project be able to name branches gc never deletes (GC_KEEP_BRANCHES, e.g. 'production release/*')? Default taken: no setting; main and the origin's default branch are kept, every other branch merged into origin/main goes under the runner's nightly --all-merged.
